summary: Deployment-readiness smoke test after the .gitignore change (the .env lines were removed). Backend 7/7 pass: admin login sets the access_token cookie, /api/auth/me works, a bad login returns 401, and an unauthenticated /api/leads returns 401. GET /api/leads, /api/dashboard/monthly, /api/lead-sources and /api/whatsapp/status all return 200 for admin. `git check-ignore` confirms backend/.env and frontend/.env are no longer ignored. Frontend: admin UI login goes to the Overview page (/). The Leads and Settings pages load and render content. The only console error is the expected 401 from the unauthenticated /auth/me check on the login page. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: The skipped-counter bug in _deliver_campaign reported in iteration_16 is still open. It was not part of this smoke test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only .gitignore changed. backend_test_v18_deploy_smoke.py is a fast smoke suite to run first (-n 0).
